item.title: Onigajo: The Demon's Castle Sea Cliffs of Kumano — Guide
item.description: Onigajo, the ‘Demon’s Castle’, is a spectacular stretch of coastline near Kumano in southern Mie, where centuries of wind, waves and tectonic uplift have carved the cliffs into a surreal landscape of honeycombed hollows, jutting terraces and cave-like recesses stacked in tiers above the crashing Pacific. A walking path threads along and through the formations, and the site — part of the Kumano Kodo pilgrimage World Heritage area — comes wrapped in legend as the lair of a demon slain by a hero of old.

item.title: Hotokegaura: Aomori's Surreal Buddha Cliffs — Guide
item.description: Hotokegaura, the ‘Buddha Shore’, is one of Japan’s most extraordinary coastlines — white dolomite columns rising up to 100 m from the Sea of Japan along the Shimokita Peninsula, their shapes likened to Buddhist saints. Reachable only by seasonal boat, it stays almost unknown to foreign visitors. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Sai Village, Shimokita, Aomori Hours Boat tours ~Apr–Oct, daytime Admission Boat tour ~¥2,000+ Time needed 1.

item.title: Kitayamazaki Cliffs: Iwate's 200 m Sea Walls — Guide
item.description: The Kitayamazaki Cliffs are one of the Sanriku coast’s grandest sights — eight kilometres of sheer 200-metre sea cliffs plunging into the Pacific. Clifftop lookouts give sweeping panoramas, while boat tours pass close to the sea caves and arches carved into the base. A raw, elemental landscape far from the crowds. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Tanohata, Iwate Hours Lookouts always open; boats seasonal Admission Free; boat tours extra Time needed 1–2 hours Best time Late spring–autumn What to See Sheer 200 m sea cliffs over 8 km of coast.

item.title: Oga Peninsula Coastline & Cape Nyudozaki — Akita Guide
item.description: The Oga Peninsula is a globally significant geopark — dramatic sea cliffs expose 50-million-year-old volcanic strata, and the famous Godzilla Rock at Kanpuzaki is a favourite for sunset photography. Cape Nyudozaki, the windswept grassy tip marked by a striped lighthouse and 40th-parallel monuments, is glorious at sunset. The 60 km coastal drive passes sea caves and fishing villages. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Oga, Akita Hours Always open (sunset best) Admission Free Time needed Half day (coastal drive) Best time Summer–autumn; sunset any clear day What to See Godzilla Rock at Kanpuzaki, a sunset icon.
